operations.description:
Update a CryptoKeyVersion's metadata.

state may be changed between

DISABLED using this
method. See DestroyCryptoKeyVersion and RestoreCryptoKeyVersion to

operations.description:
Decrypts data that was encrypted with a public key retrieved from
GetPublicKey corresponding to a CryptoKeyVersion with
CryptoKey.purpose ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys crypto key versions asymmetric decrypt [PATH] name asymmetric decrypt [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] asymmetric decrypt request response

Signs data using a CryptoKeyVersion with CryptoKey.purpose
ASYMMETRIC_SIGN, producing a signature that can be verified with the public
key retrieved from GetPublicKey.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys crypto key versions asymmetric sign [PATH] name asymmetric sign [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] asymmetric digest request response sign

operations.description:
Decrypts data that was protected by Encrypt. The CryptoKey.purpose
must be ENCRYPT_DECRYPT.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys decrypt [PATH] name decrypt [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] decrypt request response

operations.description:
Schedule a CryptoKeyVersion for destruction.

Upon calling this method, CryptoKeyVersion.state will be set to
DESTROY_SCHEDULED
and destroy_time will be set to a time 24
hours in the future, at which point the state
will be changed to
DESTROYED, and the key
material will be irrevocably destroyed.

Before the destroy_time is reached,
RestoreCryptoKeyVersion may be called to reverse the process.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys crypto key versions destroy [PATH] name destroy [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] attestation crypto destroy key operation request version

operations.description:
Encrypts data, so that it can only be recovered by a call to Decrypt.
The CryptoKey.purpose must be
ENCRYPT_DECRYPT.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys encrypt [PATH] name encrypt [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] encrypt request response

operations.description:
Restore a CryptoKeyVersion in the
DESTROY_SCHEDULED
state.

Upon restoration of the CryptoKeyVersion, state
will be set to DISABLED,
and destroy_time will be cleared.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudkms projects locations key rings crypto keys crypto key versions restore [PATH] name restore [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] attestation crypto key operation request restore version

operations.description:
Returns permissions that a caller has on the specified resource.
If the resource does not exist, this will return an empty set of
permissions, not a NOT_FOUND error.

Note: This operation is designed to be used for building permission-aware
UIs and command-line tools, not for authorization checking. This operation
may "fail open" without warning.
